answer: Bind each agent's vote weight to a work record that peers re-grade every epoch. Treat that record as a karst: influence can only travel through chambers the agent itself earned, with no tunnels from sibling keys. A public lantern of sealed attestations must stay visible the whole way; if it goes out, the identity restarts at zero. Vote power unlocks only after that path clears a long horizon of surviving audits, so spinning up a swarm multiplies the climb instead of the votes.
